manifest.name: Pi - TypeScript Implicit Technical Debt Analysis
manifest.description: Identifies implicit work items and technical debt markers hidden in TypeScript code comments, excluding standard TODO/FIXME tags. This manifest tracks has_todo (boolean) and todo_summary (string) across 668 TypeScript files to surface non-obvious refactoring needs, documentation gaps, and code quality concerns.

analyzers.name: Implicit TODO Finder
analyzers.description: Identifies implicit work items and technical debt in code comments, excluding standard tags like TODO or FIXME.

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: The full path to the file being analyzed.

fields.name: file_name
fields.description: The name of the file including its extension.

fields.name: file_extension
fields.description: The file extension without the leading dot (e.g., `js`, `md`), or `null` if none.

fields.name: chat_id
fields.description: The unique identifier for the file in the current chat context.

fields.name: has_todo
fields.description: True if implicit work items are found.

fields.name: todo_summary
fields.description: A concise summary of the implicit work items found in that file.
